mechanism: Eplerenone is a CYP3A4 substrate and mefloquine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing eplerenone levels; additionally, both drugs can cause QT prolongation and hyperkalemia risk is elevated with eplerenone.
action: Monitor serum potassium and QTc interval closely; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; if combination necessary, reduce eplerenone dose and monitor renal function.
